fields.gap: The sourced foam-core factors are Sim et al. 2024: dimple 0.20 and flat 0.22, from numerical postbuckling of small-scale hemispheres. They do not support 0.90. The paper says NASA SP-8032 at 0.18 and NASA CR-1457 at 0.20 may not provide a suitable knockdown for hemispherical foam-core shells. Their 0.18 is not this card's SP-8032 row.
fields.direction: A sandwich knockdown at R = 10 m.
fields.effect: Using 0.22 instead of 0.90 would raise required modulus by 0.90/0.22.
